Q1.en: For any two positive integers, HCF \(\times\) LCM = product of the numbers. So LCM \(= \frac{96 \times 404}{4} = 96 \times 101 = 9696\), which is the choice 9696.
Q1.hi: किन्हीं दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों के लिए HCF \(\times\) LCM = संख्याओं का गुणनफल। अतः LCM \(= \frac{96 \times 404}{4} = 96 \times 101 = 9696\), जो विकल्प 9696 है।

Q2.en: The distance of a point \((x, y)\) from the origin is \(\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\). So the distance is \(\sqrt{2^2+5^2} = \sqrt{4+25} = \sqrt{29}\) units, which is the choice \(\sqrt{29}\) units.
Q2.hi: बिन्दु \((x, y)\) की मूल बिन्दु से दूरी \(\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\) होती है। अतः दूरी \(\sqrt{2^2+5^2} = \sqrt{4+25} = \sqrt{29}\) मात्रक है, जो विकल्प \(\sqrt{29}\) मात्रक है।

Q3.en: Since \(\tan 45^\circ = 1\), the value is \(\sqrt{2}+1\), which is the choice \(\sqrt{2}+1\).

Q4.en: By the identity \(1+\tan^2 A = \sec^2 A\), we get \(\sec^2 A-\tan^2 A = 1\), which is the choice 1.
Q4.hi: सर्वसमिका \(1+\tan^2 A = \sec^2 A\) से \(\sec^2 A-\tan^2 A = 1\) प्राप्त होता है, जो विकल्प 1 है।

Q5.en: Put \(x = 1\) in the equation: \(2(1)+3y = 11\), so \(3y = 9\) and \(y = 3\), which is the choice 3.

Q6.en: Here \(a = 21\) and \(d = 18-21 = -3\). Let the \(n\)th term be \(-81\): \(a_n = a+(n-1)d\) gives \(21+(n-1)(-3) = -81\), so \((n-1)(-3) = -102\), \(n-1 = 34\) and \(n = 35\). It is the 35th term, which is the choice 35th.

Q7.en: The bag has \(2+3+4 = 9\) balls, of which \(2+3 = 5\) are not red. So the probability that the ball is not red is \(\frac{5}{9}\), which is the choice \(\frac{5}{9}\).

Q8.en: An event that is sure to happen is a sure (certain) event, and the probability of a sure event is 1, which is the choice 1.
Q8.hi: जो घटना अवश्य घटित होती है वह निश्चित घटना कहलाती है, और निश्चित घटना की प्रायिकता 1 होती है, जो विकल्प 1 है।

Q9.en: Since \(DE \parallel BC\), the triangles ADE and ABC are similar (AA similarity), so \(\frac{DE}{BC} = \frac{AD}{AB}\). Here \(AB = AD+DB = 3+6 = 9\) cm, so \(\frac{DE}{BC} = \frac{3}{9} = \frac{1}{3}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{3}\). (Check: \(\frac{AE}{AC} = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\) as well.)
Q9.hi: चूँकि \(DE \parallel BC\), अतः त्रिभुज ADE और त्रिभुज ABC समरूप हैं (AA समरूपता), इसलिए \(\frac{DE}{BC} = \frac{AD}{AB}\)। यहाँ \(AB = AD+DB = 3+6 = 9\) सेमी, अतः \(\frac{DE}{BC} = \frac{3}{9} = \frac{1}{3}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{3}\) है। (जाँच: \(\frac{AE}{AC} = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\) भी है।)

Q10.en: The radius drawn to the point of contact is perpendicular to the tangent, so the radius, the tangent and the line from \(Q\) to the centre form a right triangle with hypotenuse 25 cm. So radius \(= \sqrt{25^2-24^2} = \sqrt{625-576} = \sqrt{49} = 7\) cm, which is the choice 7 cm.
Q10.hi: स्पर्श बिन्दु पर खींची गई त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा पर लम्ब होती है, अतः त्रिज्या, स्पर्श रेखा और \(Q\) को केन्द्र से मिलाने वाली रेखा एक समकोण त्रिभुज बनाती हैं जिसका कर्ण 25 सेमी है। अतः त्रिज्या \(= \sqrt{25^2-24^2} = \sqrt{625-576} = \sqrt{49} = 7\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 7 सेमी है।

Q11.en: The length of the arc of a sector of angle \(\theta\) is \(\frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r\). So the arc \(= \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi \times 6 = \frac{1}{12} \times 12\pi = \pi\) cm, which is the choice \(\pi\) cm.
Q11.hi: कोण \(\theta\) वाले त्रिज्यखंड के चाप की लम्बाई \(\frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r\) होती है। अतः चाप \(= \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi \times 6 = \frac{1}{12} \times 12\pi = \pi\) सेमी, जो विकल्प \(\pi\) सेमी है।

Q12.en: The surface of the solid is the base circle of the cylinder, the curved surface of the cylinder and the curved surface of the hemisphere (the top of the cylinder is covered). So total surface area \(= \pi r^2 + 2\pi rh + 2\pi r^2 = \pi(9) + 2\pi(3)(5) + 2\pi(9) = 9\pi + 30\pi + 18\pi = 57\pi\) \(\text{cm}^2\), which is the choice \(57\pi\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
Q12.hi: इस ठोस के पृष्ठ में बेलन का आधार वृत्त, बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठ और अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठ आते हैं (बेलन का ऊपरी तल ढक जाता है)। अतः कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(= \pi r^2 + 2\pi rh + 2\pi r^2 = \pi(9) + 2\pi(3)(5) + 2\pi(9) = 9\pi + 30\pi + 18\pi = 57\pi\) सेमी\(^2\), जो विकल्प \(57\pi\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q13.en: The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact, so the angle is \(90^\circ\), which is the choice \(90^\circ\).
Q13.hi: वृत्त के किसी बिन्दु पर स्पर्श रेखा, स्पर्श बिन्दु से जाने वाली त्रिज्या पर लम्ब होती है, अतः कोण \(90^\circ\) है, जो विकल्प \(90^\circ\) है।

Q14.en: Use \(1+\tan^2 A = \sec^2 A\) and \(1+\cot^2 A = \text{cosec}^2 A\): \(\frac{\sec^2 A}{\text{cosec}^2 A} = \frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos^2 A} = \tan^2 A\), which is the choice \(\tan^2 A\).
Q14.hi: \(1+\tan^2 A = \sec^2 A\) और \(1+\cot^2 A = \text{cosec}^2 A\) के प्रयोग से: \(\frac{\sec^2 A}{\text{cosec}^2 A} = \frac{\sin^2 A}{\cos^2 A} = \tan^2 A\), जो विकल्प \(\tan^2 A\) है।

Q15.en: Area of a sector of angle \(\theta\) is \(\frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2\). So area \(= \frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{1}{6} \times 154 = \frac{77}{3}\) \(\text{cm}^2\), which is the choice \(\frac{77}{3}\) \(\text{cm}^2\).
Q15.hi: कोण \(\theta\) वाले त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(\frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2\) होता है। अतः क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{1}{6} \times 154 = \frac{77}{3}\) सेमी\(^2\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{77}{3}\) सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q16.en: The surface area of a sphere is \(4\pi r^2\). So \(4 \times \frac{22}{7} \times r^2 = 452\frac{4}{7} = \frac{3168}{7}\), which gives \(r^2 = \frac{3168}{88} = 36\) and \(r = 6\) cm, which is the choice 6 cm.

Q17.en: For \(ax^2+bx+c\), the product of zeroes is \(\frac{c}{a}\). Here \(a = 4\) and \(c = -1\), so the product is \(-\frac{1}{4}\), which is the choice \(-\frac{1}{4}\).
Q17.hi: बहुपद \(ax^2+bx+c\) के शून्यकों का गुणनफल \(\frac{c}{a}\) होता है। यहाँ \(a = 4\) और \(c = -1\), अतः गुणनफल \(-\frac{1}{4}\) है, जो विकल्प \(-\frac{1}{4}\) है।

Q18.en: The discriminant is \(b^2-4ac\) with \(a = 3\), \(b = -4\), \(c = \frac{4}{3}\): \((-4)^2 - 4 \times 3 \times \frac{4}{3} = 16-16 = 0\), which is the choice 0.

Q20.en: Total frequency \(n = 6+8+10+9+12 = 45\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 22.5\). The cumulative frequencies are 6, 14, 24, 33, 45. The first cumulative frequency greater than 22.5 is 24, of the class 20-30, so the median class is 20-30, which is the choice 20-30.

B1b.en:
Let the point \((-1, 6)\) divide the segment joining \((-3, 10)\) and \((6, -8)\) in the ratio \(k : 1\). By the section formula, its x-coordinate is

\(\frac{6k-3}{k+1} = -1\)

So \(6k-3 = -k-1\), \(7k = 2\) and \(k = \frac{2}{7}\).

Check with the y-coordinate: \(\frac{-8k+10}{k+1} = \frac{-\frac{16}{7}+10}{\frac{9}{7}} = \frac{54}{9} = 6\), which agrees.

Hence the required ratio is \(\frac{2}{7} : 1\), that is \(2 : 7\) (internally).

B1c.en:
Write \(\cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A}\) in the left-hand side.

\(\frac{1-\tan A}{1-\cot A} = \frac{1-\tan A}{1-\frac{1}{\tan A}} = \frac{1-\tan A}{\frac{\tan A-1}{\tan A}} = \frac{\tan A\,(1-\tan A)}{-(1-\tan A)} = -\tan A\)

So \(\text{LHS} = \left(\frac{1-\tan A}{1-\cot A}\right)^2 = (-\tan A)^2 = \tan^2 A = \text{RHS}\).

Hence proved.
B1c.hi:
बायें पक्ष में \(\cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A}\) रखते हैं।

\(\frac{1-\tan A}{1-\cot A} = \frac{1-\tan A}{1-\frac{1}{\tan A}} = \frac{1-\tan A}{\frac{\tan A-1}{\tan A}} = \frac{\tan A\,(1-\tan A)}{-(1-\tan A)} = -\tan A\)

अतः बायाँ पक्ष \(= \left(\frac{1-\tan A}{1-\cot A}\right)^2 = (-\tan A)^2 = \tan^2 A =\) दायाँ पक्ष।

इति सिद्धम्।

B1d.en:
Make the cumulative frequency table:

| Class-interval | Frequency | Cumulative frequency |
|---|---|---|
| 0-10 | 7 | 7 |
| 10-20 | 9 | 16 |
| 20-30 | 19 | 35 |
| 30-40 | 15 | 50 |
| 40-50 | 7 | 57 |

Here \(n = 57\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 28.5\). The cumulative frequency just greater than 28.5 is 35, so the median class is 20-30.

\(l = 20\), \(cf = 16\), \(f = 19\), \(h = 10\).

Median \(= l + \frac{\frac{n}{2}-cf}{f} \times h = 20 + \frac{28.5-16}{19} \times 10 = 20 + \frac{125}{19} = 20 + 6.58 = 26.58\) (approximately).

B1e.en:
Suppose, on the contrary, that \(3\sqrt{2}\) is rational. Then we can write \(3\sqrt{2} = \frac{a}{b}\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are integers and \(b \neq 0\).

Then \(\sqrt{2} = \frac{a}{3b}\). Since \(a\) and \(3b\) are integers and \(3b \neq 0\), \(\frac{a}{3b}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{2}\) would be rational.

But \(\sqrt{2}\) is irrational. This contradiction arises from our assumption, so the assumption is wrong.

Hence \(3\sqrt{2}\) is an irrational number.
B1e.hi:
इसके विपरीत माना कि \(3\sqrt{2}\) परिमेय है। तब \(3\sqrt{2} = \frac{a}{b}\) लिख सकते हैं, जहाँ \(a\) और \(b\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(b \neq 0\)।

तब \(\sqrt{2} = \frac{a}{3b}\)। चूँकि \(a\) और \(3b\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(3b \neq 0\), अतः \(\frac{a}{3b}\) परिमेय है, इसलिए \(\sqrt{2}\) भी परिमेय होगा।

परन्तु \(\sqrt{2}\) अपरिमेय है। यह विरोधाभास हमारी कल्पना के कारण है, अतः हमारी कल्पना गलत है।

अतः \(3\sqrt{2}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।

B1f.en:
Write each number as a product of primes:

\(120 = 2^3 \times 3 \times 5\)

\(315 = 3^2 \times 5 \times 7\)

The LCM is the product of the greatest power of each prime factor:

LCM \(= 2^3 \times 3^2 \times 5 \times 7 = 8 \times 9 \times 35 = 2520\).
B1f.hi:
प्रत्येक संख्या को अभाज्य गुणनखंडों के गुणनफल के रूप में लिखते हैं:

\(120 = 2^3 \times 3 \times 5\)

\(315 = 3^2 \times 5 \times 7\)

LCM प्रत्येक अभाज्य गुणनखंड की सबसे बड़ी घात का गुणनफल होता है:

LCM \(= 2^3 \times 3^2 \times 5 \times 7 = 8 \times 9 \times 35 = 2520\)।

B2a.en:
The highest frequency is 21, of the class 30-40, so the modal class is 30-40.

Lower limit of the modal class \(l = 30\), class size \(h = 10\), frequency of the modal class \(f_1 = 21\), frequency of the preceding class \(f_0 = 18\), frequency of the succeeding class \(f_2 = 15\).

Mode \(= l + \frac{f_1-f_0}{2f_1-f_0-f_2} \times h\)

\(= 30 + \frac{21-18}{2 \times 21-18-15} \times 10\)

\(= 30 + \frac{3}{9} \times 10 = 30 + 3.33 = 33.33\) (approximately).

Hence the mode is 33.33.
B2a.hi:
सबसे अधिक बारम्बारता 21 है, जो वर्ग 30-40 की है, अतः बहुलक वर्ग 30-40 है।

बहुलक वर्ग की निम्न सीमा \(l = 30\), वर्ग माप \(h = 10\), बहुलक वर्ग की बारम्बारता \(f_1 = 21\), पूर्ववर्ती वर्ग की बारम्बारता \(f_0 = 18\), परवर्ती वर्ग की बारम्बारता \(f_2 = 15\)।

बहुलक \(= l + \frac{f_1-f_0}{2f_1-f_0-f_2} \times h\)

\(= 30 + \frac{21-18}{2 \times 21-18-15} \times 10\)

\(= 30 + \frac{3}{9} \times 10 = 30 + 3.33 = 33.33\) (लगभग)।

अतः बहुलक 33.33 है।

B2b.en:
Given: a circle with centre O, and P an external point from which two tangents PQ and PR are drawn, touching the circle at Q and R.

To prove: \(PQ = PR\).

Construction: Join OP, OQ and OR.

Proof: The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact, so \(\angle OQP = \angle ORP = 90^\circ\).

In the right triangles OQP and ORP:

\(OQ = OR\) (radii of the same circle)

\(OP = OP\) (common hypotenuse)

\(\angle OQP = \angle ORP = 90^\circ\)

So \(\triangle OQP \cong \triangle ORP\) (RHS congruence).

Therefore \(PQ = PR\) (corresponding parts of congruent triangles).

Hence the lengths of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal.
B2b.hi:
दिया है: केन्द्र O वाला एक वृत्त, तथा बाह्य बिन्दु P से वृत्त पर दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ PQ और PR खींची गई हैं, जो वृत्त को बिन्दुओं Q और R पर स्पर्श करती हैं।

सिद्ध करना है: \(PQ = PR\)।

रचना: OP, OQ और OR को मिलाया।

उपपत्ति: वृत्त के किसी बिन्दु पर स्पर्श रेखा, स्पर्श बिन्दु से जाने वाली त्रिज्या पर लम्ब होती है, अतः \(\angle OQP = \angle ORP = 90^\circ\)।

समकोण त्रिभुजों OQP और ORP में:

\(OQ = OR\) (एक ही वृत्त की त्रिज्याएँ)

\(OP = OP\) (उभयनिष्ठ कर्ण)

\(\angle OQP = \angle ORP = 90^\circ\)

अतः \(\triangle OQP \cong \triangle ORP\) (RHS सर्वांगसमता)।

इसलिए \(PQ = PR\) (सर्वांगसम त्रिभुजों के संगत भाग)।

अतः बाह्य बिन्दु से वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं की लम्बाइयाँ समान होती हैं। इति सिद्धम्।

B2c.en:
Let the first triangle be PQR with \(PQ = 3\) cm, \(QR = 6\) cm, \(RP = 8\) cm, and the second triangle be XYZ with \(XY = 4.5\) cm, \(YZ = 9\) cm, \(ZX = 12\) cm.

Compare the corresponding sides:

\(\frac{PQ}{XY} = \frac{3}{4.5} = \frac{2}{3}\)

\(\frac{QR}{YZ} = \frac{6}{9} = \frac{2}{3}\)

\(\frac{RP}{ZX} = \frac{8}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\)

So \(\frac{PQ}{XY} = \frac{QR}{YZ} = \frac{RP}{ZX} = \frac{2}{3}\), that is, the corresponding sides of the two triangles are in the same ratio.

By the SSS similarity criterion, \(\triangle PQR \sim \triangle XYZ\).

Hence the two triangles are similar.
B2c.hi:
माना पहला त्रिभुज PQR है जिसमें \(PQ = 3\) सेमी, \(QR = 6\) सेमी, \(RP = 8\) सेमी, तथा दूसरा त्रिभुज XYZ है जिसमें \(XY = 4.5\) सेमी, \(YZ = 9\) सेमी, \(ZX = 12\) सेमी।

संगत भुजाओं की तुलना करने पर:

\(\frac{PQ}{XY} = \frac{3}{4.5} = \frac{2}{3}\)

\(\frac{QR}{YZ} = \frac{6}{9} = \frac{2}{3}\)

\(\frac{RP}{ZX} = \frac{8}{12} = \frac{2}{3}\)

अतः \(\frac{PQ}{XY} = \frac{QR}{YZ} = \frac{RP}{ZX} = \frac{2}{3}\), अर्थात् दोनों त्रिभुजों की संगत भुजाएँ एक ही अनुपात में हैं।

SSS समरूपता कसौटी से \(\triangle PQR \sim \triangle XYZ\)।

अतः दोनों त्रिभुज समरूप हैं। इति सिद्धम्।

B2d.en:
Let the fraction be \(\frac{x}{y}\).

First condition: \(\frac{x+1}{y+1} = \frac{4}{5}\), so \(5x+5 = 4y+4\), that is \(5x-4y = -1\) ... (1)

Second condition: \(\frac{x-5}{y-5} = \frac{1}{2}\), so \(2x-10 = y-5\), that is \(2x-y = 5\) ... (2)

Multiply (2) by 4: \(8x-4y = 20\) ... (3)

Subtract (1) from (3): \(3x = 21\), so \(x = 7\).

From (2): \(y = 2x-5 = 14-5 = 9\).

Check: \(\frac{7+1}{9+1} = \frac{8}{10} = \frac{4}{5}\) and \(\frac{7-5}{9-5} = \frac{2}{4} = \frac{1}{2}\).

Hence the fraction is \(\frac{7}{9}\).

B2e.en:
Factorise by splitting the middle term. Here \(9 \times (-2) = -18\), and \(-6\) and \(3\) have product \(-18\) and sum \(-3\).

\(9x^2-3x-2 = 0\)

\(9x^2-6x+3x-2 = 0\)

\(3x(3x-2)+1(3x-2) = 0\)

\((3x-2)(3x+1) = 0\)

So \(3x-2 = 0\) or \(3x+1 = 0\), giving \(x = \frac{2}{3}\) or \(x = -\frac{1}{3}\).

Hence the roots are \(\frac{2}{3}\) and \(-\frac{1}{3}\).

B2f.en:
Let the first term be \(a\) and the common difference \(d\), so \(a_n = a+(n-1)d\).

Third term: \(a_3 = a+2d = 16\) ... (1)

Seventh term is 12 more than the fifth term: \(a_7 - a_5 = 12\), that is \((a+6d)-(a+4d) = 12\), so \(2d = 12\) and \(d = 6\).

From (1): \(a = 16-2 \times 6 = 4\).

Hence the A.P. is 4, 10, 16, 22, 28, ...

B3a.en:
The given equations are

\(5x+y = 3\) ... (1)

\(6x-5y = \frac{1}{2}\) ... (2)

Multiply (1) by 5: \(25x+5y = 15\) ... (3)

Add (2) and (3) to eliminate \(y\):

\(31x = 15+\frac{1}{2} = \frac{31}{2}\), so \(x = \frac{1}{2}\).

Put \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) in (1): \(5 \times \frac{1}{2} + y = 3\), so \(y = 3-\frac{5}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\).

Check in (2): \(6 \times \frac{1}{2} - 5 \times \frac{1}{2} = 3-\frac{5}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\), which is correct.

Hence \(x = \frac{1}{2}\) and \(y = \frac{1}{2}\).

B3b.en:
Let the length of the rectangle be \(x\) m and the breadth \(y\) m, so its area is \(xy\) \(\text{m}^2\).

First condition: \((x+2)(y-2) = xy-28\)

\(xy-2x+2y-4 = xy-28\), so \(-2x+2y = -24\), that is \(x-y = 12\) ... (1)

Second condition: \((x-1)(y+2) = xy+33\)

\(xy+2x-y-2 = xy+33\), so \(2x-y = 35\) ... (2)

Subtract (1) from (2): \(x = 23\).

From (1): \(y = x-12 = 23-12 = 11\).

So the length is 23 m and the breadth is 11 m.

Area of the rectangle \(= 23 \times 11 = 253\) \(\text{m}^2\).

Check: \(25 \times 9 = 225 = 253-28\) and \(22 \times 13 = 286 = 253+33\).

B4a.en:
Let PQ be the building of height 20 m with foot P, and QR the flagstaff of height \(h\) m on its top. Let \(OP = x\) m. Then \(\angle POQ = 30^\circ\) and \(\angle POR = 45^\circ\), and \(\angle OPQ = 90^\circ\).

In right triangle OPQ:

\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PQ}{OP}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{20}{x}\) and \(x = 20\sqrt{3}\) m.

In right triangle OPR:

\(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PR}{OP}\), so \(1 = \frac{20+h}{20\sqrt{3}}\) and \(20+h = 20\sqrt{3}\).

So \(h = 20\sqrt{3}-20 = 20(\sqrt{3}-1) = 20 \times 0.732 = 14.64\) m.

And the distance \(OP = 20\sqrt{3} = 20 \times 1.732 = 34.64\) m.

Hence the height of the flagstaff is \(20(\sqrt{3}-1)\) m \(\approx 14.64\) m, and the distance of the foot of the building from \(O\) is \(20\sqrt{3}\) m \(\approx 34.64\) m.
B4a.hi:
माना PQ भवन है जिसकी ऊँचाई 20 मी तथा पाद P है, और QR उसके शिखर पर \(h\) मी ऊँचा ध्वजदंड है। माना \(OP = x\) मी। तब \(\angle POQ = 30^\circ\), \(\angle POR = 45^\circ\) तथा \(\angle OPQ = 90^\circ\)।

समकोण त्रिभुज OPQ में:

\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PQ}{OP}\), अतः \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{20}{x}\) और \(x = 20\sqrt{3}\) मी।

समकोण त्रिभुज OPR में:

\(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PR}{OP}\), अतः \(1 = \frac{20+h}{20\sqrt{3}}\) और \(20+h = 20\sqrt{3}\)।

अतः \(h = 20\sqrt{3}-20 = 20(\sqrt{3}-1) = 20 \times 0.732 = 14.64\) मी।

तथा दूरी \(OP = 20\sqrt{3} = 20 \times 1.732 = 34.64\) मी।

अतः ध्वजदंड की लम्बाई \(20(\sqrt{3}-1)\) मी \(\approx 14.64\) मी तथा बिन्दु \(O\) से भवन के पाद की दूरी \(20\sqrt{3}\) मी \(\approx 34.64\) मी है।

B4b.en:
Let P be the point on the bridge and M the point on the river (on the line joining the banks) directly below it, so \(PM = 4.5\) m. Let Q and R be the points on the opposite banks, with angles of depression \(30^\circ\) to Q and \(45^\circ\) to R. Since the angle of depression equals the angle of elevation (alternate angles), \(\angle PQM = 30^\circ\) and \(\angle PRM = 45^\circ\).

In right triangle PMQ:

\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PM}{QM}\), so \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4.5}{QM}\) and \(QM = 4.5\sqrt{3}\) m.

In right triangle PMR:

\(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PM}{MR}\), so \(1 = \frac{4.5}{MR}\) and \(MR = 4.5\) m.

Breadth of the river \(QR = QM + MR = 4.5\sqrt{3} + 4.5 = 4.5(\sqrt{3}+1)\) m

\(= 4.5 \times 2.732 = 12.294\) m.

Hence the breadth of the river is \(4.5(\sqrt{3}+1)\) m, about 12.29 m.
B4b.hi:
माना पुल पर बिन्दु P है और उसके ठीक नीचे नदी (दोनों किनारों को मिलाने वाली रेखा) पर बिन्दु M है, अतः \(PM = 4.5\) मी। माना सम्मुख किनारों पर बिन्दु Q और R हैं, जिनके अवनमन कोण क्रमशः \(30^\circ\) और \(45^\circ\) हैं। चूँकि अवनमन कोण उन्नयन कोण के बराबर होता है (एकान्तर कोण), अतः \(\angle PQM = 30^\circ\) और \(\angle PRM = 45^\circ\)।

समकोण त्रिभुज PMQ में:

\(\tan 30^\circ = \frac{PM}{QM}\), अतः \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4.5}{QM}\) और \(QM = 4.5\sqrt{3}\) मी।

समकोण त्रिभुज PMR में:

\(\tan 45^\circ = \frac{PM}{MR}\), अतः \(1 = \frac{4.5}{MR}\) और \(MR = 4.5\) मी।

नदी की चौड़ाई \(QR = QM + MR = 4.5\sqrt{3} + 4.5 = 4.5(\sqrt{3}+1)\) मी

\(= 4.5 \times 2.732 = 12.294\) मी।

अतः नदी की चौड़ाई \(4.5(\sqrt{3}+1)\) मी, लगभग 12.29 मी है।

B5a.en:
The largest sphere that can be cut from a cube has a diameter equal to the side of the cube. So the diameter of the sphere is 14 cm and its radius \(r = 7\) cm.

Volume of the cube \(= a^3 = 14^3 = 2744\) \(\text{cm}^3\).

Volume of the sphere \(= \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{4}{3} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{4312}{3} = 1437.33\) \(\text{cm}^3\).

Volume of the peeled wood \(= 2744 - \frac{4312}{3} = \frac{8232-4312}{3} = \frac{3920}{3} = 1306.67\) \(\text{cm}^3\) (approximately).

Hence the volume of the peeled wood is \(1306\frac{2}{3}\) \(\text{cm}^3\).
B5a.hi:
घन से काटे जा सकने वाले महत्तम गोले का व्यास घन की भुजा के बराबर होता है। अतः गोले का व्यास 14 सेमी और त्रिज्या \(r = 7\) सेमी है।

घन का आयतन \(= a^3 = 14^3 = 2744\) सेमी\(^3\)।

गोले का आयतन \(= \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{4}{3} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{4312}{3} = 1437.33\) सेमी\(^3\)।

छिली हुई लकड़ी का आयतन \(= 2744 - \frac{4312}{3} = \frac{8232-4312}{3} = \frac{3920}{3} = 1306.67\) सेमी\(^3\) (लगभग)।

अतः छिली हुई लकड़ी का आयतन \(1306\frac{2}{3}\) सेमी\(^3\) है।

B5b.en:
The shaded portion is the part of the sector OAB (radius 14 cm) outside the sector OCD (radius 7 cm), both with angle \(\theta = 30^\circ\) at the centre \(O\).

Area of sector OAB \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi R^2 = \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{1}{12} \times 616 = \frac{154}{3}\) \(\text{cm}^2\).

Area of sector OCD \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{1}{12} \times 154 = \frac{77}{6}\) \(\text{cm}^2\).

Area of the shaded portion \(= \frac{154}{3} - \frac{77}{6} = \frac{308-77}{6} = \frac{231}{6} = \frac{77}{2} = 38.5\) \(\text{cm}^2\).

Hence the area of the shaded portion is 38.5 \(\text{cm}^2\).
B5b.hi:
छायांकित भाग, त्रिज्यखंड OAB (त्रिज्या 14 सेमी) का वह भाग है जो त्रिज्यखंड OCD (त्रिज्या 7 सेमी) से बाहर है; दोनों का केन्द्र \(O\) पर कोण \(\theta = 30^\circ\) है।

त्रिज्यखंड OAB का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi R^2 = \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{1}{12} \times 616 = \frac{154}{3}\) सेमी\(^2\)।

त्रिज्यखंड OCD का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7 \times 7 = \frac{1}{12} \times 154 = \frac{77}{6}\) सेमी\(^2\)।

छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{154}{3} - \frac{77}{6} = \frac{308-77}{6} = \frac{231}{6} = \frac{77}{2} = 38.5\) सेमी\(^2\)।

अतः छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल 38.5 सेमी\(^2\) है।
